scripts.forge:upgrade:tldraw:staging: pnpm forge:deploy:disable-analytics && forge install --upgrade --site "$ATLASSIAN_SITE" --product confluence -e staging --non-interactive --verbose
scripts.forge:upgrade:tldraw:production: pnpm forge:deploy:disable-analytics && forge install --upgrade --site "$ATLASSIAN_SITE" --product confluence -e production --non-interactive --verbose
